stem: What can the reader infer about the crows based on their actions after Father Crow talks to the fox?

options.label: A
options.text: They worry that the snake will harm the servants.

options.label: B
options.text: They often visit the royal ladies and servants at the river.

options.label: C
options.text: They want to give the necklace to the fox.

options.label: D
options.text: They trust the fox and the plan he shares.
